title: Police Commission rule on rapid adjudication complaints
summary: The Police Commission chair proposed a rule letting the commission skip complaints the department already settled through its rapid adjudication process. After an executive session, the commission deferred the rule change to its next meeting.

timeline.text: The rule change discussion will continue at the next meeting.
Item 7, changes to the rules of the police commission: The commission deferred the rule changes and will continue the discussion at its next meeting.
Motion to continue discussion of rule changes in executive session: The commission voted by roll call to continue the rules discussion in executive session (a closed-door discussion).
The chair proposed a rule letting the commission skip complaints the department already settled through its faster rapid adjudication process.
